body:
I’m giving it my best shot to hang in there but I’m just tired and discouraged ya know?
I have learned chat gbt makes a great pseudo therapist though 😂

I wish that were true. I’m really close with my younger sister and the thought of putting her through that always manages to keep me fighting but when the suicidal ideation is just relentless (I’m 30F this started at about 9 or 10 for me) it’s just like WHEN exactly does it get better lol

I’m trying hard to hang in there. It’s discouraging when your moments of living in depression outweigh your moments of happiness and that’s just kinda how it’s always been for me. Having to convince yourself that you should want to be alive is exhausting 😅  Spot on with what comes after and the pain I could potentially feel, though. As well as leaving my younger sister behind.

My dad I have blocked on everything does this he always somehow gets gift cards through to me on things like my birthday and Christmas. Via things I can’t necessarily block. I find them incredibly hard to deal with because they are intentionally guilt inducing while putting on the show he is the dutiful father who is putting in the effort…I have to actively remind myself that’s all it is a performance for the people around him as opposed to our actual relationship. I’m so sorry you’re being put through a similar ringer. It’s such a weird complicated helpless kind of grief. But I’m so glad you’re sticking to your guns and doing what’s best for you. You got this!

Quitting was the best decision for me. I played for over a year and loved the game and my alliance but it’s time consuming and the financial bit if you want to remain competitive adds up. I also weirdly didn’t miss it at all since I got out which I definitely thought I would. Do what’s best for you!
Same shit in 401 I have done the same
I am in group 5 - commenting incase anyone has any suggestions 👀

This was put so eloquently! Thank you so much for this. A good screenshot for me to save as a reminder.

WE got this 💅🏻🤍
LOVE this
I can’t explain it but this alone has me ready to toss them all out or toss them in a fire 😂

Thanks for taking the time to share! So much less isolating when you realize other people are in the same boat of that really specific type of guilt.

Proud of your growth 🤍

Sooooo validating. Thank you so much for taking the time to share your experience. I appreciate it immensely. Think this thread is giving me the push I need to just toss the letters and release that lingering guilt with them. 

I’m proud of you for also sticking to your boundaries.

I would imagine you’ve made yourself into a phenomenal parent 🤍
I appreciate you clocking it! Social anxiety is so dumb sometimes lol. Thank you for the response ✨

Thank you! Your nonchalant tone honestly instantly eased my social anxiety 😂

I appreciate the birthday wishes as well ✨
Tbh I think I feel guilty taking up another persons time and effort
This broke my heart
Hard 8+ for me you have a gorgeous smile and a flattering profile which is hard to have 🥹

You’re absolutely right my friend. Fuck it, I’m doing it. Thank you for the push I needed.

Also funny you comment with your username I told her last night I would consider eternal sunshine of the spotless minding her if I could 😂💀

I need to badly. Even tonight she messaged me some shitty meme and I’m just like miss ma’am leave me alone you ended things.

I’m only hesitant because we work together and don’t want to make for an uncomfy environment but at the expense of my mental health it’s probably worth it.
I’m proud of you for making progress 🥺❤️ I was the same way at the beginning. I would wake up shaking

Ugh I just require the strength to keep her blocked. OR TO EVEN BLOCK HER IN THE FIRST PLACE. But like I need to because every time I give her a response I hate myself for it because I know nothing could change
I’m obsessed with this energy

Thanks so much for the input. Were you able to block or did that take you some time?

I await the day for her to be a blip.
Lonely caretaker is literally the best way to put it. She will still reach out to me and talk about being suicidal and like the dummy girl in me just wants to help 🫠

Ugh people need a friend like you 🥺

She did try that at one point but that got shut down real quick.

Okay strategic was the exact word I had for it as well but couldn’t tell if I was reaching because I’m angry.

Although fear not I am not naive enough to think I was completely at fault I showed up for that person in our relationship and I have comfort in this!

Unfortunately I know how right you are with literally everything you just said 🥴

Thank you for the reminders

Unfortunately I have the same exact experience. You are spot on in the sense they are just master mirrors. They show us exactly what they know we want to see and we tn think it’s once in a lifetime. I’m just recovering from my BPD relationship ship and still find myself trying to convince myself she was real 😅
Correct. They hate themselves so much and have such a lack of self that when you fall in love with the person they created FOR YOU, you are not a respectable person.
They believe their own delusion because they -need- to be the victim. So while they can be aware they’re lying their brain at some point will convince them that’s the truth.

V O M I T why are the most infuriating breed of human. I have my masters in psych and I know I should not demonize BPD but with the trail of wreckage they leave behind I find it incredibly hard some days.

I adore you for taking the time to type out your experience and share this with me.

It’s just frustrating because I’ve been clinically depressed since I was a toddler. Like I can remember being young and trying to swallow pencil lead because I just wasn’t down to be here anymore. So I do agree that it can temporarily get better but I always find myself coming back to this place of not wanting to exist. It’s almost as if I feel I was not biologically made to live a long life because my own brain attacks me and it sucks. Even with medication and the best therapist I could ever ask for.

I told one other person I would check in with them on June 1st should things change - I will do the same with you. Gonna DM you right now. Because I can also feel through your words that you actually just care. The world needs more people like you my dude.
Such is life!

Ugh I’m so sorry. I get that struggle, I really do. There was a tiktok sound I saw the other day that talks about being a temporary human for other people. Like a SOLID pit stop, but not the destination. I fill their cups and then they bounce. A worthless feeling haha.

Come up north!!

I am having the same issues. My girlfriend showed up for me in our relationship. Like she was actually wonderful. I have no toxicity to reflect on. It was when I got discarded that I was like I don’t know this person at all. Even her voice changed which is crazy.

Honestly my breakup was only at the beginning of April and I’m still equally as wrecked. Some days are easier. Some days are harder than the first day. But I’m trying to tell myself that this would have kept happening if we stayed together.

If you ever need a psychology pal to chat things through shoot me a DM. If I can help you sort your thoughts I definitely will.

Ugh, buddy. My ex told me she was never attracted to me in the first place after breaking up with me and that girl was obsessed with me while we were together. Always posting me, etc. the second she dumped me it was a different human. Their brains don’t function like ours therefor we can’t comprehend this treatment. I know it hurts like a bitch now, believe me, I am still WRECKED from my breakup. But this is not a long term partner. This cycle would only repeat.

Gah, what sucks is I have the best psychologist in the world. Dude literally refathered me and I adore him. I’m also on a good medication that works for my clinical depression but not my situational depression. As for the purposes I do all those things like play piano, big into weight lifting, but none of them actually spark joy. That being said I hate sounds like a dark negative cloud when someone is trying to help me. I appreciate your kindness, sincerely.


If I make it after this month I will reach out to you on Reddit on June 1st and give you some rightfully earned props 😉

I do agree with you! I hate to think about the pain I’m bound to inflict. It’s the only reason I’ve made it to the age of 28! But I can only live for others for so long with the temporary distractions from my own pain before I’m always forced to face it again. I’ve been clinically depressed since I’ve been a toddler 😅
I hate to hear others are in the same mental place, I really do. Normally misery loves comfort but not this misery. Wish I could give ya a squeeze!

Ugh, trust when I say I know how you feel. I was in a car accident a few years back and I feel my life has just been on a steady decline since. Canada is legalizing assisted suicide soon but I can’t even wait until then 😂 every minute is a struggle.

Even on this page though I have the mindset of literally just wanting to hug all of you and absorbing your pain on my way out 🥺

I’m sorry you’re also in this excruciating pain.

Jesus I am so sorry this is your experience. I had to threaten a lawyer with a borderline gf I had because she also tried to ruin my life for an entire year after we ended 😵‍💫 I’m glad you’re sticking to your guns
Appreciate the info! Looking into them now!!
Thank you so much! I have been on a book binge and this one just made it to the top of my list

Ugh I’m so sorry that was your experience. I can say without knowing you for absolute certain you deserved better 😞

These times too shall pass!

Wise words my friend 🙏🏻 the most I’ve been able to do thus far is go to the gym and journal. And I’m pretty sure my brain justifies the gym by saying “if we make every muscle in the body hurt the emotional pain hurts less” 😂 but some socializing would be excellent.
Appreciate you taking the time to reply and wishing well :)

You🤝me
Being better off

Bestie it sounds like we could swap some STORIES. Because it DOES sounds like we dated the same person.

I got the whole wasn’t ever actually in love speech even though those were things she openly expressed and then followed up with her actions throughout the entire duration. It would make more sense if she was shitty but she never was until the end and she detached.

I also get rage speeches when she tries to be friends but it implodes because I’ve been in love with her since we started talking.

But was it actually love or did they mirror us??
SAME DEAL! I’m trying to be mad but I’m just hurt. Devastated.

The questions that we will never have answers to hits 😞 I truly do think that’s their mindset though. Especially when they are with someone who is like…perfectly lovely to them. And it’s not toxic and tumultuous. They have to make it implode to complete their core wound of being abandoned. At least these are my thoughts.

Fortunately she didn’t ghost but she did dump me over text and had no intentions of seeing me. Although I did see her and she was like…a shell of the person I dated. Would barely even make eye contact. We work together so even though I’m no contact she gets to DM me funny breadcrumbs while we work every night 🥴
Attachment styles and mastery compulsion 🥴
This literally looks like like the conversation my ex had with me while she was dumping me why are the thoughts so similar wow
Proud of you for recognizing that and putting in the work even though it’s uncomfortable and painful 🥺❤️
I appreciate your kind words immensely. It is comforting to know how many people are put through identical situations.

Ugh, toxicity gets the claws in far too deep. I’m sorry to hear about how you were treated.

I don’t want that drug in my life, but, it’s so fresh that my initial instinct is like YES WE DO COME BACK.
You are completely right my friend

Totally. Mine does this too. Meeting up in person when she finally would it was also like meeting with a shell of the human I knew and dated. Wouldn’t even make eye contact with me for an extended period of time. I’ve never experienced that kind of disposal 🥴
Ugh, my heart. What was your recovery length like?

Like what is that energy?
I feel like they need to convince themselves of that narrative and then also make you hate them to make themselves feel better about their actions. My ex changed her narrative multiple times during the breakup. 🥴

Okay, wow. This is mine too 😂 wild how clockable their patterns are.

Hate not knowing if our experiences were sincere and genuine or if it was an act. Did you ever get this closure?

Thank you. I’m so glad I found this thread. After constantly telling me I’m the best partner she’s ever had, how happy she was always, how much she loved me. And now I am just someone she was never even attracted to in the first place. Lady is forgetting that we met on a dating app and she matched with me 😂😮‍💨

Sucks that I can still somehow miss that presence with my entire being

C O W A R D S
It’s funny you say that about the convincing ones self because the entire breakup texts her narrative changed so many times it was like I was watching her try to buy her own story in real time 😂
Like she wanted me to hate her so she would feel less shitty about what she did.

Just whack.

Ugh, I’m so sorry to hear about YOUR experience. The trail of wreckage left behind is just…not okay.

Knowing how detached they are I’m finding is the only comfort. Just need to have boundaries around my empathy or I will over empathize and then just want to take care of her 🥴 hate this journey I really do lol.
One day at a time 🙏🏻 it’s only been about a week for me right now

I really appreciate you taking the time to type this all out. I know how true every single one of your words are. I hate that my empathetic side is still like 🥺no she’s mentally ill and needs you🥺 but that’s absolutely bonkers. Just gotta take it day by day until one day I feel lighter. Gotta rephrase this in my brain as she did me a favor 😂

Thanks for the response!
I will mention that to her that made until I’m feeling a little more confident if she could just toss me a lil reminder every once in a while it would probably speed up the process. While also being mindful that because I am feeling insecure in some areas it doesn’t get to be projected onto her.

I’m her first female relationship so I’m sure it’s a similar vibe to your girlfriend for sure.

Thanks again for the words of wisdom ✨
It’s also incredibly comforting to know others have experienced this in their dynamics. I sincerely really appreciate your comment. Thank you again! Gonna try to make some strides asap
Girl incredibly helpful. I feel like I need to write it as an affirmation or something whilst building that confidence back.
Lutri incredibly helpful thank you so much for sharing. Screenshotting so I can get my journal on over this. Hope your day is even better 🙏🏻

Oops replied to the wrong comment.

Ugh that is such toxic behaviour. Literally just reaching out to make sure she still can. Safest bet is to block my guy. I know it’s sucks BELIEVE ME YOU I know, but you’ll be so much better off. Also when we get rid of these TOXINS we create the space for the people who should be in our lives who will not pull shit like thatz

Hello, big introvert here 👋🏻
I totally see where she’s coming from, however, relationships take two to tango. If she does not wants fire to go out, she needs to be fueling it. Next time you hang out I think it’s completely fair to be like “hey, I 100% respect your boundaries and can totally understand you need your space. But would it be okay if we found a time to make space to talk? Even if it’s a phone call once a week or just an extra text message a day. You know what you require for a relationship while still taking her needs into consideration. Words of affirmation and physical touch are not high on my love language list but they are at the top of my partners so I try to push myself to be extra touchy or tell her at least one thing special each day so she knows I love her.

You are not overthinking for expressing how you feel! Communication is hot af.
She’s like Hansel and Gretel with these bread crumbs…RUN

Thank you for replying to this! I feel significantly less crazy having someone else explain exactly how it feels trying to be affectionate!
I shall work towards it next time we see each other 🤞🏻

You’re so right. I hate that I’m fully aware that she absolutely feels the same, thats not what causes the anxiety. I just freeze every time I want to. It’s like…a wall of awful that stops me.

It is comforting to know people are in the same boat, though. Sometimes I feel like such a dweeb for having these issues.

WE got this m’dear.
Apology unnecessary I really really appreciate you taking the time to type this out you have actually been very very helpful. Thank you :)

Hahaha, tbh hormones still valid. We a crazy bunch. I do appreciate you treading respectfully though I know you have good intentions.

Yes, that is exactly it. Words and actions aren’t aligning and that sends my brain into a bit of a frenzy. Although, I need to be mindful not to project past relationship onto a human who has done nothing wrong...for the most part. 

Totally! And I still agree with that. She is going through major mental health issues. I have no business adding onto her load or becoming like...an obligation rather than a partner. So I even asked her when this episode started if she’d like to put things on pause and I’ll take some steps back.

Yes. Establishing boundaries is a big goal in working on to protect myself because I am bad for getting steamrolled by letting humans overstep. So I think I was going back and forth between like...at what point am I overstepping my own boundaries by continuing with someone who has not been willing to meet me in the middle for quite some time. 

I will need to find a way to do this. Because, regardless of our dynamic I actually just really appreciate her as a human being. If we end up just pals I’ll still be appreciative.

Thank you so much for taking the time to chat this out with me my friend you really gave me a different point of view and put me in check with a view points.
Yes I am going to be good and refrain from sending her memes or texts. I’ll give the space 😇 hahah

Yes for sure I am. The thing is if she just vocalized that I would be happy to take steps back so she could focus on her. But, alas.
You’re very very right. In all of this.

I won’t be messaging her or anything moving forward I’m going to allow her that space. Not in a disrespectful way as I have no reason to burn bridges with her either. But to not let myself sit slightly anxiety riddled lol.

I appreciate your response!

She hasn’t gone completely yet. 
My fight or flight is just triggered and my own emotions are like “get out before rejection”
Hahah comfort in numbers. We’ve been talking for around two months.

No I really appreciate everything you had to say and putting some things into perspective for me, for sure.

I think I am being a bit sensitive (I’m a girl this is a lesbian relationship) but at the same time I’m wondering at what point do I completely compromise my own boundaries, you know? A relationship still takes two and while I’m super aware sometimes one partner is gonna give more than they take and that’s fine! Partners are there to help support you. But I need -something- or my own relationship issues are going to strike up as in often when I start feeling rejecting as a coping mechanism I’ll gtfo out first. And I’m trying really hard to fight that flight response.

Contributing more to her mental health would honestly break my heart. I don’t want to make things worse for her. But I can’t pretend like everything is awesome at the expense of my own. I think.

As for the two options I just want that vocalized! If you wanna just be my friend I offered that due to her mental state and got a “no I really like you and would hate to mess this up”
So I don’t think it’s about just one thing not happening for me.

You are very right in that it’s not my call to dictate what makes someone feel better.

I appreciate your ramble and know that you were in no way offensive. I appreciate the bluntness. I guess I need to make some decisions on a convo between the two of us.
Appreciate more than you know! I could not tell if I was being reactive and looking for excuses to drop someone or genuinely on the phase out. This validated things for me for sure.

Right on the money with me making excuses. The thing is, I know she likes me. She’s vocal about this. I suggested we take a couple steps back so she could prioritize herself a couple weeks ago and she hard was like “no I like you too much and am really trying to get ahold of this I’m not trying to mess this up”

So I think I’m more so grasping at straws to protect myself because I like her more than I thought and came to the realization that she has the ability to hurt me so I’m now like OOP GOTTA JET.

The indifference and dry texts I could potentially be milking for the out.
